Input conversion outside timing; graph construction, optional weighted backward, gradient clearing and result destruction included. No native Torch/GPU, universal speedup or RSS claim.

memory.scope: CPU tracemalloc incremental tracked allocations with inputs created before tracing; forward retained/peak and separate backward peak. Pre-existing input storage is excluded in both variants. Not total tape memory, process RSS or WASM heap size.

limitations: Eight fractional-gradient cases use scalar FP64 norm qualification, not per-element native passes.
64 empty-pdist backward cases use an independent contract after native process crashes; native forward is compared.
All cdist compute-mode names retain stable direct differences; native matrix-dispatch/rounding and forward AD are not implemented.
Existing dense CPU/WASM, half NN/AD, complex AD and 0.53/0.56 numerical limits remain. No GPU claim.
